projects.title: SeismoXAI
projects.description: An end-to-end pipeline for foreshock-versus-aftershock classification from seismic waveforms, using CNNs on time-frequency representations and SHAP-based explainability.

projects.title: European Match Predictor
projects.description: A static web app for predicting Champions League, Europa League, Conference League and major European league matches. It combines recent form, Elo, xG, home/away performance and a Poisson model with Dixon-Coles correction to estimate 1X2 probabilities, exact scores, Over 2.5 and BTTS.
